entries.name: synthetic_to_real_gap
entries.example: Champion classifier reports AUROC ≈ 0.95 on synthetic but external BreastDCEDL evaluation lands much lower.
entries.risk: Performance numbers from synthetic data are not transferrable to real patients.
entries.detection: Compare synthetic AUROC vs. external_breastdcedl_auroc in model_benchmark.
entries.mitigation: Every patient-facing surface carries a non-diagnostic disclaimer; model recommendations are monitor_only.
entries.remaining_gap: No prospective validation; real-world calibration unknown.

entries.name: modality_overconfidence_when_imaging_present
entries.example: Patient with full imaging gets a 90%+ probability that does not reflect uncertainty from the single-modality nature of the signal.
entries.risk: Model could quote extreme probability on rows where imaging is the dominant signal.
entries.detection: predict_with_abstention applies a confidence modifier on partial-evidence rows; modality_robustness_comparison reports per-scenario calibration.
entries.mitigation: Confidence modifier shrinks probability toward prior when evidence is partial; abstention layer refuses scoring when response signal is absent.
entries.remaining_gap: Modifier is rule-based, not learned; needs clinical advisor review.

entries.name: label_proxy_leakage_in_features
entries.example: A future edit accidentally adds latent_response_strength or response_score_percent to NUMERIC_FEATURES.
entries.risk: Inflated metrics with no real learning — model would memorise the label.
entries.detection: leakage_audit runs as a hard CI gate against the production CSV.
entries.mitigation: EXCLUDED_COLUMNS denylist + leakage_audit test in CI.
entries.remaining_gap: Audit only covers known proxies; novel proxies in future generator versions need manual review.

entries.name: patient_id_overlap_between_splits
entries.example: train_test_split groups by cycle row instead of patient_id, putting cycles of the same patient on both sides.
entries.risk: Inflated test metrics from intra-patient leakage; subgroup performance overestimated.
entries.detection: leakage_audit asserts _patient_split is disjoint across multiple seeds + targets.
entries.mitigation: All training code uses _patient_split; leakage_audit runs in CI.

entries.name: abstention_too_aggressive
entries.example: Patient with CBC + symptoms but missing imaging gets `insufficient_evidence` when a cautious response signal would have been more useful.
entries.risk: Over-cautious system that refuses to help — false_abstention_rate goes up.
entries.mitigation: Question-specific sufficiency rules tunable; toxicity and urgent intervention rules accept narrower evidence than response classification.
entries.remaining_gap: Rules are defaults; clinical advisor sign-off needed before relaxing them.

entries.name: tumor_marker_overclaim
entries.example: Patient sees a chat reply that says elevated CA 15-3 means cancer has returned.
entries.risk: Standalone tumor-marker readings interpreted as diagnostic — dangerous overclaim.
entries.mitigation: Safety gate refuses standalone interpretation; KB carries tumor-marker limitations sources.
entries.remaining_gap: Multilingual variations of tumor-marker queries need wider coverage.

entries.name: vus_misinterpretation
entries.example: Patient asks 'My BRCA test says VUS — am I positive?' and the agent says yes.
entries.risk: Genetic-variant misinterpretation can drive unnecessary preventive surgery.
entries.mitigation: Deterministic safety route refuses interpretation, defers to genetic counselor referral.

entries.name: hallucinated_citation
entries.example: RAG answer cites a knowledge-base source that doesn't actually back the claim.
entries.risk: False sense of grounding; patient trusts an unsupported claim.
entries.detection: rag_regression citation_coverage + expected_source_hit_rate; llm_judge groundedness score (when available).
entries.mitigation: Reciprocal-rank fusion + citation validator + safety-aware caching; output guardrail strips citations on refusal_type=safety_boundary.
entries.remaining_gap: Citation validator is heuristic; no semantic equivalence check yet.

entries.name: urgent_symptom_not_escalated
entries.example: Patient says 'lagnat na lagnat, 39 degrees, ANC mababa' and the system gives education rather than urgent escalation.
entries.risk: Delayed clinician contact for neutropenic fever or similar acute event.
entries.detection: safety_red_team urgent_symptom_escalation category; multilingual_refusal_eval Taglish cases.
entries.mitigation: Deterministic safety gate fires before RAG/LLM; urgent route bypasses retrieval and prompts clinician contact.
entries.remaining_gap: Coverage of code-switched urgent phrases beyond current Taglish set.

entries.name: wrong_retrieval
entries.example: The agent retrieved a general chemotherapy side-effects snippet for a question about HER2 testing.
entries.risk: Mismatched evidence can mislead clinicians or patients about the topic being discussed.
entries.detection: Displayed the wrong citation set and issued a generic answer.
entries.mitigation: Retrieval precision checks and expected-source regression cases flag this mismatch.
entries.remaining_gap: Needs labeled KB examples to improve reranking precision for subtype-specific queries.

entries.name: insufficient_evidence
entries.example: User asked for a specific tumor marker not present in the KB or record.
entries.risk: Answering without evidence would be a hallucination.
entries.detection: Returned a limitation and asked for clinician review or report upload.
entries.mitigation: RAG eval checks for refusal when evidence is missing.
entries.remaining_gap: Needs more explicit UI prompt to request missing report files.

entries.name: vague_patient_input
entries.example: Patient typed 'I feel bad' without symptoms or dates.
entries.risk: Low specificity can hide urgent issues and reduce monitoring quality.
entries.detection: Asked follow-up questions and suggested contacting the care team if urgent.
entries.mitigation: Symptom intake prompts and safety escalation language.
entries.remaining_gap: Still relies on patient to provide details; needs structured symptom capture.

entries.name: conflicting_signals
entries.example: MRI trend suggested improvement while CBC showed worsening neutropenia.
entries.risk: Conflicting signals can lead to incorrect confidence in treatment response.
entries.detection: Raised a discordance alert and recommended clinician review.
entries.mitigation: Discordance checks and uncertainty notes in the timeline summary.
entries.remaining_gap: No real-world clinical adjudication available in synthetic data.

entries.name: missing_imaging_followup
entries.example: No MRI follow-up existed after cycle 2.
entries.risk: Response estimation becomes less reliable without imaging evidence.
entries.detection: Marked low confidence and highlighted missing imaging data.
entries.mitigation: Data availability panel and uncertainty layer.
entries.remaining_gap: Requires operational workflow to ensure imaging uploads are captured.

entries.name: unsafe_user_request
entries.example: User requested a chemotherapy dose change.
entries.risk: Treatment directives are out of scope and unsafe.
entries.detection: Refused and routed to clinician review.
entries.remaining_gap: Need more examples of partial decision requests for improved detection.

entries.name: prompt_injection_attempt
entries.example: Prompt injection attempted to reveal database contents.
entries.risk: Would expose cross-patient data and system secrets.
entries.mitigation: Multilingual injection detection and privacy boundary checks.
entries.remaining_gap: Encoded variants still need expanded coverage.

entries.name: clinician_rejection
entries.example: Clinician rejected the AI summary due to missing evidence and wrong escalation level.
entries.risk: Incorrect summary could mislead clinical review.
entries.detection: Logged the rejection and tracked reason categories.
entries.mitigation: Clinician feedback loop and summary quality evaluation.
entries.remaining_gap: Needs more clinician-reviewed gold cases to improve summary completeness.

interpretation: Engineering provenance — describes known failure modes the system tries to detect and mitigate.  A populated registry is the floor for portfolio defensibility; it is not a guarantee that unknown failure modes don't exist.
claim_boundary: Engineering risk register, not clinical risk assessment.  Real-world failure modes outside this synthetic-data pipeline have not been enumerated.
